purpose: Teach: 断面/壁面/踊ら/西暦/果たさ/救命/抵触/徴兵

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、本気で、絶対、歴史の断面、絶対、丁寧に、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派
lines.en: Ren, your paper handled the historical context with such genuine care and thoughtfulness. It was truly impressive.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Slight pause before naming him—setting the serious tone. Even pace, steady eye contact. The specific praise lands with precision, not gush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の建築、本気で、絶対、壁面、絶対、独特な、装飾、論文で、扱いました、本気で、絶対、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I was careful to treat the architectural details of that period with accuracy and depth in my research.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude beneath the surface. Controlled, slightly formal register—respect without stiffness. Even breath through the longer sentences. A small hesitation before 'thank you' that suggests genuine feeling.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、人々、絶対、踊らされた、絶対、宣伝、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: You really showed how people were swept up in propaganda during the war. Your scope was impressively broad—I was genuinely moved by how thoughtfully you engaged with that complexity.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly, voice steady and measured. Genuine intellectual engagement. Slight emphasis on the word 'swept'—recognising the weight of the subject. Slower pace on the praise, letting it land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。西暦の年代、本気で、絶対、正確に、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: I tried to be precise with the dates and historical timeline. It felt important to get those details right for the argument to hold. Thank you for noticing the depth of the work.
lines.style: Soft-spoken, almost apologetic in tone despite the confidence of the work. Earnest about the 'why' behind the choices. Steady but unhurried. Ends quietly, without inflection—accepting praise rather than deflecting.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時、本気で、絶対、役割を、絶対、果たさず、絶対、苦しんだ、絶対、政治家、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: The way you examined politicians who failed in their responsibilities during that period—who struggled under the weight of those circumstances. That kind of nuance is rare, and it shows real intellectual maturity.
lines.style: Slightly slower pace, more reflective. Voice carries genuine respect. Pause before 'struggled'—acknowledging the human cost. Warm but not sentimental. The final sentence delivered with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、救命活動、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対、感謝、本当に
lines.en: I wanted to show the rescue efforts that happened during the war—how people took action, often at great personal risk. Understanding that history seemed essential to the paper.
lines.style: Quieter, more introspective. Slight hesitation at the start—choosing words carefully. Steadier pace when discussing the rescue efforts, as if lending weight to those stories. Ends with modest certainty, not seeking validation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、法に抵触、絶対、する活動、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you handled the activities that skirted the law during wartime—the moral complexity of survival. That's the kind of historical thinking that stays with you.
lines.style: Measured, reflective tone. Slight emphasis on 'skirted the law'—acknowledging the difficult truth. Slower delivery, giving space to the ideas. Voice carries genuine intellectual respect and something like awe at his engagement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時、本気で、絶対、徴兵、絶対、制度、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I made sure to explore the conscription system thoroughly—how it functioned, what it meant for people's lives. It felt crucial to understand that mechanism to understand the period at all.
lines.style: Calm, assured but not proud. Measured pace throughout. The explanation carries quiet conviction about why these choices mattered. Ends with gratitude that feels earned, not performed—a genuine closing.
